mechanisms.name: crack propagation obstruction by Ti2AlN particles

evidence.quote: the fracture of Ti 2AlN is observed as crack extends toward Ti 2AlN particle, implying that the crack expansion is obstructed by Ti 2AlN particles, which is beneﬁcial for the enhancement of bending strength

the reinforced phase of TAN-15 substantially maintains the particle state before deformation, while that of TAN-35 with blocky structure is crushed and separated into particles, which demonstrates that the blocky reinforced phase plays a load-carrying role in compressive process to improve the compressive strength
Ti 2AlN particle with higher hardness can effectively impede the slide of dislocation, thereby leading to the optimization of mechanical properties
